Overview

PlaywrightJS is a comprehensive testing framework designed for automated, browser-based end-to-end testing of web applications. It helps developers validate their apps across multiple environments, ensuring quality and reliability.

Why PlaywrightJS?

This project aims to streamline cross-browser testing with robust automation. The core features include:

  • 🎯 🧪 Cross-Browser Support: Test your application seamlessly across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
  • 🚀 ⚙️ CI/CD Integration: Automate tests within your deployment pipelines for continuous quality assurance.
  • 🔄 🛠️ Parallel Testing & Retries: Speed up test runs and improve stability with configurable retries.
  • 📊 📄 Detailed Reports: Generate comprehensive HTML reports for easy test result analysis.
  • 🔧 📝 Customizable Configuration: Easily tailor test execution settings to fit your project needs.

Getting Started

Prerequisites

This project requires the following dependencies:

  • Programming Language: JavaScript
  • Package Manager: Npm

Installation

Build PlaywrightJS from the source and install dependencies:

  1. Clone the repository:

    ❯ git clone https://github.com/herit6-hanu/PlaywrightJS

  2. Navigate to the project directory:

    ❯ cd PlaywrightJS

  3. Install the dependencies:

Using npm:

❯ npm install

Usage

Run the project with:

Using npm:

npm start

Testing

Playwrightjs uses the {test_framework} test framework. Run the test suite with:

Using npm:

npm test
